caption:
You're B1… but you still say these 😬

5 grammar mistakes that make intermediate learners sound like beginners, with the rule in one line.

Save it 📌 and tell me which one you say the most 👇

#learnenglish #englishgrammar #englishmistakes #b1english #esl

slides.title: You're B1… but you still say *these* 😬

slides.label: Present perfect
slides.tip: Started in the past, still true → *have + V3*

slides.label: Look forward to
slides.wrong: I look forward to see you

slides.label: If clauses
slides.wrong: If I will have time, I'll call you
slides.right: If I *have* time, I'll call you
